verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API-first service, and its own Sandbox supports fully programmatic use. The /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint creates test Items via the API without the client-side Link UI, and the official plaid-node SDK makes server-side calls, so automated test runs can work end to end without a browser. However, real-user Items still depend on the interactive Link component, and nothing documents CI specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless setup documentation, an official CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and a headless path for non-Sandbox Item creation.
